wire_contracts.name: scene_start
limits: local indexed SceneList only; no filename or arbitrary Lua buffer
busy is not queue; caller can change review flag before busy return

wire_contracts.name: scene_report
limits: nonzero quest End sends only if CheckConfirmMessage converted result equals1
no content-success, world-clear, cleanup or reward meaning

wire_contracts.name: map_change
limits: point clear/controller reset precede same-ID shortcut

wire_contracts.name: point_delta
limits: existing first matching point only; not upsert or position change

wire_contracts.name: npc_intent
limits: bounded modal consumer, not universal001C business meaning
local scene can begin before network send; NPC context must be checked

wire_contracts.name: wait_release
limits: bounded dialog/mask2 release; not Q/coroutine/native-owner drain ACK
no run/generation token; stale suppression is Server queue responsibility
